logical_geometry.logical_index: (selected135/cube cell, one of the three quotient GQ lines through its packet)

symmetry: The 405 local logical coordinates split canonically into 27 disjoint groups of 15 indexed by the GQ lines. PSp and the PGSp outer automorphism permute those groups, so the even-line and repetition-line couplings are PGSp-invariant.
distance_proof: For the even-line code total logical weight is even. Logical weight two must be two distinct cells in one quotient-line group and therefore has disjoint physical supports of weight 7+7=14. Logical weight at least four has physical weight at least 4W >= 16 because the local weights for h=1,2,3 active logical bits are 7,8,15. For the repetition code, selecting one quotient line activates one logical coordinate in each of 15 cells, giving weight 105; the local weight function 0,7,8,15 is strictly increasing, so adding quotient lines cannot reduce weight.
execution: independent reconstruction of the cube/cell K6 partition, all 405 weight-7 logical generators and their GF(2) rank 405, the 27x15 logical grouping, explicit weight-14 witness, and rank-27 repetition rows
theorem: Canonical GQ-line coupling of the 135 local [15,3,7]_2 cells yields an exact PGSp-invariant [2025,378,14]_2 code: only 27 dimensions are sacrificed from Pass4748's [2025,405,7]_2 direct sum while the distance doubles from 7 to 14 and K*d rises from 2835 to 5292. The extreme repetition coupling gives [2025,27,105]_2.
boundary: Exact binary-code construction and distance proof. No universal coding optimum or physical fault-tolerance threshold is claimed.
